description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 5204
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in Homagama, Colombo District. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
